value.produces: amix-system.hdf golden master (AMIX 2.1 OPEN LOOK desktop; cold-boot reset)

labctl.notes: HOST-NATIVE: FS-UAE 3.2.35 (its OWN copy at assets/amix/fsuae-native, built from the merged source with fsuae-slirp-hostfwd.patch, FSUAE_STATION=amix) runs an Amiga 3000 (68030+MMU, Kickstart 2.04 r37.175) with an A2410 TIGA board on the host inside a pinned 1024x768 Xvfb; the guest's X -tiga server drives the board (OPEN LOOK, 256 colours) and the daemon captures the X root (SH_CAPTURE=x11). No QEMU/QMP, no exec channel (in.telnetd does listen on 23 inside the guest -- a cheap follow-up). POINTER: ABSOLUTE via the GUEST's X server (SH_INPUT_BACKEND=x11test + SH_X11TEST_MOTION=warp + SH_X11WARP_DISPLAY=127.0.0.1:72). The UAE mousehack is an AmigaOS trap AMIX never registers, so any XTEST motion is relative+accelerated there; instead the A2065 runs on slirp and the launcher adds a LOOPBACK-ONLY redirect 127.0.0.1:6072 -> 10.0.2.15:6000 (the board's X server listens on the same :0); the daemon warps (XWarpPointer) and reads back (XQueryPointer); buttons/keys ride XTEST into the Xvfb with each button edge held until the warp is confirmed. Single injector: never push motion at this guest by another path (no xdotool mousemove on the live Xvfb). The pointer is dead while the guest X server is (boot ~90 s; x11warp-check.log says ok / STALE GOLDEN / TIMED OUT). In RTG mode the capture is identity-mapped (no stretch, zoom only affects the boot console). Golden (unified 2026-09-01) carries the colour session, /etc/inet/hosts amix=10.0.2.15 + slirphost=10.0.2.2 (rc.inet brings aen0 up; NO default route), and xhost +slirphost in both /etc/kh-xsession and /etc/kh-xsession.mono. Reset=relaunch: cold boot of a fresh work HDF copied from disk/amix-system.hdf.golden; no statefile. Framebuffer-proven 2026-09-01 on the shipping binary at 1024x768: readback exact and sprite on target at 16 points incl. all four corners, residual 0 px; click and keys proven by guest response (docs/guests/amix.md). Launcher stations/amix/x11-runtime.sh.

render.stationsManifestPrelude: # amix — host-native FS-UAE 3.2.35 (A3000, 68030+MMU, Kickstart 2.04) -> Amiga UNIX (AMIX) 2.1, System V R4 with the OPEN LOOK desktop, in COLOUR on an A2410 (1024x768, 8-bit PseudoColor, selected by starting AMIX's X server with -tiga). The chipset X server is depth 1, so monochrome 640x512 is the fallback and is one flag away (/etc/kh-xsession.mono in the guest). Absolute 1:1 pointer via x11warp into the guest's own X server over a loopback-bound slirp redirect.

pointer.device: guest X server (X -tiga on the A2410; motion via loopback slirp redirect) + amiga-mouse/keyboard over XTEST (buttons, keys)

museum.lineage: Commodore Amiga / AT&T UNIX System V Release 4 (ported by Commodore)
museum.arch: Motorola 68030 @ 25 MHz with MMU + 68882 FPU, A2410 graphics board (Amiga 3000)
eraSoftware: X11R4 and the AT&T OPEN LOOK toolkit (OLIT)
museum.periodBrowser: none — this station is offline, and in 1992 a Unix machine's network was uucp and Usenet: AMIX ships C News, NNTP and an SVR4 TCP/IP stack, not a browser
museum.blurb: Commodore licensed AT&T's System V Release 4 and shipped it on the Amiga 3000, wearing OPEN LOOK — the desktop AT&T specified for SVR4, and the one Motif beat — instead of Workbench. Nobody ever published how many sold. This one has the A2410 graphics board fitted, so it runs OPEN LOOK in colour: the option that took the price from $4,998 to $7,713.
museum.notes: Live streamhost tile, HOST-NATIVE from birth: FS-UAE 3.2.35 on the host under a pinned Xvfb, x11 root capture + XTEST input, with its own copy of the binary (rule 6). Installed from real media — the AMIX 2.1 boot/root floppies and the 29-segment installation tape (amigaunix.com) restored through UAE's SCSI tape emulation onto a 2 GB RDB disk, exactly as a real A3000UX did it. SHIPS IN COLOUR: the pinned FS-UAE build does drive the Commodore A2410, and AMIX's X server comes up on it at 1024x768 depth 8 PseudoColor (256 colours) when started with -tiga — /usr/X/bin/X and /usr/X/bin/X2410 are byte-identical, so the board is selected by that flag alone. The earlier 'FS-UAE compiles the A2410 code but never calls it' verdict was a tool artefact: ugrep skipped the ISO-8859 gfxboard.cpp as binary, and the dispatch functions are named tms_*, not a2410_*. The 640x512 depth-1 chipset session is kept in-guest as /etc/kh-xsession.mono, so monochrome is a one-line revert. Historically the A2410 was a $998 option and most A3000UX owners ran the mono chipset screen; the poster says so. Distinct from amiga (A500/WB1.3), amigaos35 (A4000/OS 3.5) and aros. See docs/guests/amix.md.

network.note: A2065 on FS-UAE slirp, used ONLY for the pointer: a loopback-bound redirect 127.0.0.1:6072 -> guest 10.0.2.15:6000 lets the daemon drive the guest's X server. Fail-closed: the guest has no default route (only 10.0.2.0/24), the redirect binds 127.0.0.1, and there is no retronet tap. Not a retronet join; a web-plane join remains a follow-up.

reset.mouse: PASS (2026-09-01) — ABSOLUTE through the guest's own X11R4 server: SH_X11TEST_MOTION=warp warps with XWarpPointer and reads back with XQueryPointer over the launcher's loopback-only slirp redirect 127.0.0.1:6072 -> 10.0.2.15:6000; buttons/keys stay on XTEST and a button edge waits for the confirmed warp. Framebuffer-proven sweep in docs/guests/amix.md.
reset.fixture: AMIX 2.1 OPEN LOOK desktop in 256 colours at 1024x768 on the A2410 (X -tiga): steel-blue root, grey OPEN LOOK frames with SteelBlue4 title bars; an xterm titled 'Amiga UNIX 2.1' (black on white, 80x24 at +40+120) showing 'UNIX_System_V amix 4.0 2.1 0800430 Amiga (Unlimited) m68k' over a root shell; xcalc (TI-30 layout with OPEN LOOK's rounded buttons, gray85); a light-yellow xclock with black hands and a red second hand. Started from /etc/inittab (entry 'xw', run level 2) via xinit /etc/kh-xsession -- /usr/bin/X11/X -tiga, so the desktop is up without a login. TWO KNOWN SCENE DEFECTS (docs/guests/amix.md "Open"): (1) ~1 cold boot in 5 comes up WITHOUT xclock -- a guest-side race in /etc/kh-xsession, fixable only by a re-baked golden, and relaunch is the visitor's reset button; (2) *pointerFocus: true is set but a fresh boot leaves the pointer at (0,0) over the ROOT, so NOTHING holds keyboard focus until the visitor moves the mouse. resetMode=relaunch with no statefile: reset is a COLD BOOT of a fresh work HDF copied from disk/amix-system.hdf.golden (chipset console text for ~60 s, board active at ~60 s, desktop by ~90 s). BAKE RULE: halt the guest with /sbin/shutdown -y -g0 -i0 (typed with the pointer INSIDE the xterm -- pointerFocus) before copying the golden; UFS has no host-repairable dirty flag. Pointer PASS 2026-09-01, re-verified 2026-09-02 on the fleet artifact streamhost-70c8c313 at 1024x768: XWarpPointer into the board's X server, readback exact and sprite on target at 16 points incl. all four corners, residual 0 px; click PASS (a warped XTEST click on xcalc's '7' put 7 on its display); keyboard PASS (typed 'echo ok-KEYS' printed in the xterm).
